what: First flashes of a NUCLEO-H533RE with STM32CubeProgrammer 2.23.0, run as test plans on a shared bench (agentic-hil serve), one entry per job. The previous image runs from flash; the image after it is `next`. `hot_plug_first_flash_*` and `under_reset_first_flash_*` ran the same plan, tests/hil/h533re_first_flash_shared_bench.yaml, and differ only in `debuggers.<name>.connect_mode`; the previous image has its independent watchdog running (about 100 ms). `hot_plug_control` is tests/hil/h533re_hotplug_control_shared_bench.yaml, whose previous image runs from flash under a 1 kHz interrupt and starts no watchdog. The two `hot_plug_retry_*` entries flash `next` again after a failed first flash, without a watchdog running, and the two `*_reset_after_flash` entries are a flash with `reset_after_flash: true` (after the interrupt image under hot plug, after the watchdog image under reset). Each job's `plan_sha256` is the SHA-256 of the plan file it sent; the plans of the retry and reset_after_flash entries are not in the repository, and their steps are the events listed. Two more hot-plug first-flash jobs never reached the measured flash, because the failed flash before them had left IWDGRSTF set and the previous image then leaves its watchdog off; they are not recorded here. The cause of the failure #743 recorded on this board type is not established, and the firmware that ran before it is not known.
bench: NUCLEO-H533RE (STM32H533, Cortex-M33, device ID 0x478) through its on-board STLINK-V3, ST-LINK firmware V3J13M4, Linux, agentic-hil serve
connect_mode_reader: Only flash_firmware reads connect_mode: the reset steps in these jobs connected Normal and the memory reads Hot Plug, whatever the entry said.
reset_flags: RCC_RSR of the STM32H533 (RM0481 table 118): a reset through the NRST pin alone sets PINRSTF (0x04000000) and no other flag; a reset the core asks for sets SFTRSTF beside it (0x14000000). The previous image clears the flags at its boot, so a read after the flash shows the resets of the flash.
limits: One board, one ST-LINK firmware, one STM32CubeProgrammer version. A core that merely runs from flash did not fail here (`hot_plug_control`); the watchdog image did. A first flash under hot plug failed with the two lines of #743 in three jobs and with `Download verification failed` in three. An earlier series on agentic-hil 0.28.0 used the same source with a 9.6 KB payload: 3 of 4 hot-plug first flashes ended in the two lines of #743, and one programmed and verified, with IWDGRSTF in the flags the next image printed; the payload was then enlarged so that the download outlasts the watchdog.
redaction: The probe's serial number is `[redacted]` and the private directory an image was staged in is `[staging]`. Of the UART lines between two programmer calls the last complete one is kept, and of several flashes in a job only the last one's transcript.
